largeIconResources.configuration: MamlIconsHelper._generateLargeIconConfigFile @ 0xcaab58; pool strings at 0x37740, 0x37748, 0x37750: apps, runtime_largeicon.config, data/system/theme/large_icons

Phone W=(spanX-2)*cellWidth+cellHeight+iconSize; H=(spanY-1)*cellHeight+iconSize. The added widget top padding is subtracted by the height getter.

nativeGeometryBridge.function: FuncBridge.invoke_method @ 0x64ae9c; full native snapshot, borrowed UTF-8 pointer/length, nullable owned input Bundle, owned output Bundle or null
nativeGeometryBridge.caller: 0x4c3a40..0x4c3b58: getCellWidth with null input, drop returned Bundle once
nativeGeometryBridge.cApi: libhyper_os_schema_public.so existing DT_NEEDED; Bundle_get_f64 returns native tag64/double struct, Bundle_get_f32 tag32/float struct; tag low bit 0 means present. Verified wrappers @ 0xa53470 and 0xa53588. Bundle_drop called once per owned result.
nativeGeometryBridge.importResolution: Resolve the launcher's bound R_AARCH64_JUMP_SLOT imports by name from its SHA-256-verified ELF: Bundle_get_f64 @ 0xe652f0, Bundle_get_f32 @ 0xe63660, Bundle_drop @ 0xe62458. These ELF virtual addresses are evidence, not hardcoded runtime offsets. Read each bound pointer through the safe runtime reader and require dladdr to identify the exact symbol in the unique loaded libhyper_os_schema_public.so. Do not dlopen a dependency through the injected module's different linker namespace.
nativeGeometryBridge.thread: One dedicated pthread, started only by background PaletteWorker after full Profile validation and after synchronous loader startup completes; never invoke on Dart UI, transaction or loader threads. Missing handler returns null. A blocked invocation cannot spawn more workers.
nativeGeometryBridge.protocol: MONOICON_GEOMETRY 1 pid profileDigest nonce32 followed by six finite scalars in response; request and response atomic in launcher DE, stale nonce/PID/digest rejected; snapshot all six values twice and require agreement.
nativeGeometryBridge.queries: getCellWidth(result,portrait_cell_width,landscape_cell_width) and getCellHeight(result): native f64. getIconScales(portrait_icon_scale,landscape_icon_scale): native f32. No Android provider exposes all three raw handlers.

hdIconUpdateRefresh.change: PNG mode replaces an unconditional void log call with static IconCacheV2.clear; the callback then performs its original action/package validation, legacy icon cache clear, model reload and controller update. Revision 5 additionally repairs changed-proxy widget reload and notifies folder previews; identical-drawable guards remain original.
hdIconUpdateRefresh.validation: Original ELF and AArch64 call convention verified statically; final rendering requires device verification.

circleAnimationAlpha.reason: fillTopEdge/fillBottomEdge extend opaque pixels into the circular PNG's transparent corners before the animation clips it to the system shape.
circleAnimationAlpha.replacement: NOP the four void edge-fill calls in circle PNG mode only; both callers reload live values afterward. Original image conversion, allocation sites, async frames, disposal and padding stay intact.
circleAnimationAlpha.validation: Confirmed against SHA-256-pinned 6144 ELF and AArch64 disassembly; no device test performed.

folderPreviewReload.scope: PNG and circle PNG modes only; scalar and disabled modes keep original instructions.

folderEntryReload.reason: The revision 5 folder_preview_container_id notification does not reconstruct cached per-slot preview entries.
folderEntryReload.abi: At 0x194ac28, x1 is reloaded with the FolderIconGetxController. Both calls return void; updateFolderUI has no optional arguments and ignores the old ids stack slot. The following instruction reloads the folder iterator.
folderEntryReload.path: For closed folders updateFolderUI refreshes sorting and calls refreshPreviewIcons -> loadItemIcons -> runLoadAction. runLoadAction constructs new preview entry objects from the adapter and assigns the RxList at 0x90ffa8. Open folders use refreshGridView.
folderEntryReload.scope: PNG modes only. Existing identical-drawable guard prevents unchanged icons from being rerendered on each preview rebuild.

folderMamlFallback.source: FolderPreviewIcon._buildIconItem calls _buildDefaultIconWidget at 0x13d1444 and stores the result in context field 0x2b at 0x13d144c. The dispatch closure loads this field into x6 at 0x13d4590/0x13d4594 before calling _buildMamlIcon at 0x13d45b0.
folderMamlFallback.effect: Calendar, clock and other MAML previews return the existing normal preview widget, retaining its size, key, model binding and themed drawable. No live MAML widget or stale MAML snapshot is used by this branch.
folderMamlFallback.dispatchExtent: Anonymous closure 0x13d4534..0x13d4668: frame prologue, three returning branches, then the named _buildNormalIcon symbol. The complete closure and its named caller are pinned as ABI evidence.
folderMamlFallback.preserved: No change to non-MAML big-icon previews, app pairs, normal desktop icons, scalar mode or disabled behavior; the transaction restores original prologue instructions when PNG mode is disabled.
